title: references create-from-catalog rejects a URL that is already a Reference instead of returning it
description:
Reported by the Machines on Machines story-development session on CLI 5.105.0.

Related: PPY-b3032b25 (create-from-catalog and prepare-catalog rough edges), PPY-85653616 (create-from-catalog timeouts leave the outcome unknown). Not a duplicate of either.

Observed: running references create-from-catalog for a URL that is already stored as a Reference fails with 'Stored intake provenance conflicts with the immutable source record'. Example: Storey's cognitive-debt essay.

Feature: Creating a Reference from a URL that already exists
  Scenario: The URL is already stored
    Given a Reference already exists for a URL
    When an editor runs references create-from-catalog with an entry for the same URL
    Then Papyrus matches the existing Reference
    And returns it, marked as already existing
    And changes nothing on the stored record, including its intake provenance
  Scenario: A new URL
    Given no Reference exists for a URL
    When an editor runs references create-from-catalog for it
    Then a Reference is created as today
  Scenario: A batch with a mix
    Given a catalog of new and already stored URLs
    When it is created
    Then each entry reports created or existing, and none fails because of the existing ones

Design: match on the canonical URL before writing, and return the existing record. The immutable source record stays immutable; the provenance check applies only to records being written.
